(Capacity: 12,508) |champion= Legends Classic Champions |bowl=[[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = round of 32 }} {{2013–14 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2013–14 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Pittsburgh]] during the [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team played its home games at the [[Petersen Events Center]] in [[Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania]]. This was Pittsburgh's inaugural season in the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]], having moved from the [[Big East Conference (1979–2013)|Big East Conference]]. Pitt had been in the Big East since 1982. They finished the season 26–10, 11–7 in ACC play to finish in fifth place. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2014 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] where they lost to Virginia. They received an at-large bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated Colorado in the second round before losing in the third round to Florida.
